infoLinks.content:
From Monday 2 March to Friday 10 July, the Manly Fast Ferry service will depart Circular Quay from Wharf 6 to an altered timetable. 
 
For all other services, please check indicator screens and listen for announcements.
 
Plan ahead at transportnsw.info
infoLinks.subtitle: Manly Fast Ferry altered timetable
